purpose: Bounded local feasibility probes for Sequoia/OpenAI/Citadel Securities No Limit preparation

icm.validation: exhaustive finish-order oracle for n=2..6, 100 player values

icm_gamble_example.note: Illustrative static ICM gamble, not an event payout prediction or a full hand decision

methodology.timer: time.perf_counter_ns; individual call durations in microseconds; default interpreter/OS scheduling
methodology.icm_fixtures: 100 random positive stack vectors per table size, repeated20 times; warmups excluded; pure Python hero-only subset dynamic program
methodology.hand_evaluation_fixtures: 1000 random seven-card hands, repeated5 times; card parsing excluded
methodology.equity_fixtures: 100 random hero/flop combinations; native heads-up against1326 uniformly weighted legal combinations, repeated5 times; Python multiway against uniformly random opponents, repeated3 times
methodology.validation: ICM outputs compared to exhaustive finish-order enumeration for2..6 players and payout conservation; equity examples computed exactly with eval7
caveats: Not the official runtime, Agent interface, or a complete decision loop
Native modules and prewritten artifacts require organizer clarification
Equity functions are Holdem-specific; no hidden variant assumption
Noisy tail latencies and observed maxima are not worst-case guarantees
Raw equity versus random hands does not model action-conditioned ranges or future betting
These are feasibility measurements, not bot strength, win-rate, or tournament-score measurements
